text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 55 vials of nafcillin sodium 2 g/8 mL with 3.5 days of supply at 15.9 vials per day. Corvale General holds 402 vials with 25.8 days at 15.6 vials per day. Corvale Lakeside holds 46 vials with 15.7 days at 2.9 vials per day. The 1 g/4 mL presentations at all three sites have 20 to 28 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): As of 2026-10-21, FDA's drug shortage list does not include nafcillin sodium. The product label for NDC 55150012316 lists three registered plants: Apitoria Pharma Private Limited (FEI 3004051616) with a VAI inspection ending 2025-12-12, Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3004446312) with an OAI inspection ending 2025-09-05, and Eugia SEZ Private Limited (FEI 3011905047) with a VAI inspection ending 2019-03-01.

Our position: No FDA shortage posting exists. Internal transfer can resolve the low supply at Corvale East. The OAI classification at Aurobindo Pharma Limited should be monitored for any future supply impact.

Recommended actions:
1. Execute transfer of 168 vials of 2 g/8 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Monitor the OAI inspection status for Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3004446312) — requires buyer to track FDA updates.

Not recommended: Purchases from Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc., Avenacy Inc., or Baxter Healthcare Corporation at this time; their labels name no identifiable plants and no FDA shortage listing justifies emergency procurement.
